source_attribution.title: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary files, 2023

assets.title: Counties and county equivalents
assets.description: 3,235 counties and equivalents, including Puerto Rico and the island areas. Every source row and field and the geometry GDAL decodes are kept, in NAD83 (EPSG:4269). Added columns: source_row, gaz_funcstat (functional status from the 2023 gazetteer), popest_2023 (1 July 2023 estimate) and bbox. Rows follow a Hilbert curve.

assets.title: Incorporated places and census designated places
assets.description: 32,608 places. gaz_funcstat A marks an incorporated place with an active government; census designated places carry no population estimate. Every source row and field and the geometry GDAL decodes are kept, in NAD83 (EPSG:4269). Added columns: source_row, gaz_funcstat (functional status from the 2023 gazetteer), popest_2023 (1 July 2023 estimate) and bbox. Rows follow a Hilbert curve.

assets.title: County subdivisions
assets.description: 36,367 county subdivisions. gaz_funcstat A marks a township or town with an active government, found in 20 states. Every source row and field and the geometry GDAL decodes are kept, in NAD83 (EPSG:4269). Added columns: source_row, gaz_funcstat (functional status from the 2023 gazetteer), popest_2023 (1 July 2023 estimate) and bbox. Rows follow a Hilbert curve.

citation: US Census Bureau. 2023 cartographic boundary files (1:500,000): counties, places and county subdivisions; 2023 gazetteer files; vintage 2023 subcounty population estimates.
description: The 2023 Census cartographic boundary files for counties, places and county subdivisions as three GeoParquet files. Every source row and field and the geometry GDAL decodes are kept, in NAD83 (EPSG:4269). Added columns: source_row, gaz_funcstat (functional status from the 2023 gazetteer), popest_2023 (1 July 2023 estimate) and bbox. Rows follow a Hilbert curve. These are boundaries generalised for mapping at 1:500,000, as of 1 January 2023, not legal boundaries.
